newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish repo allocates 13.5 bln SKR to market.
newsitem.headline: Swedish repo allocates 13.5 bln SKR to market.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Tuesday it allocated 13.5 billion crowns ($1.7 billion) to the market in its weekly repurchase operation.
The one-week repo was set at an unchanged, fixed rate of 4.10 percent, as expected, and will run from July 16 to July 23.
The operation replaces an operation that allocated 14 billion crowns to the market.
The Riksbank said 59.34 percent of the bids for the tender were allocated.
-- Belinda Goldsmith, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1017 ($ = 7.788 Swedish Crowns)
